evidence.observation: Exhaust O2 rising monotonically during growth: 8.4 -> 17.1 -> 22.9 -> 30.8 ppm, well above the ~7 ppm purged baseline
Tube pressure climbing steadily 3.04 -> 3.27 Torr while Ar setpoint/flow are constant at 100 sccm
MFC steady at ~100 sccm, so the pressure rise is not from increased inlet flow
Temperature holds 750 °C with plausible heater power, so heating control is normal

args.missing_evidence: A flow-off pressure-rise (leak-up) test or Ar step change to distinguish air ingress through a seal from a partial exhaust restriction; also whether O2/P keep rising or plateau.
